newsitem.title: CANADA: Rio Algom/Inmet raise Antamina resource.
newsitem.headline: Rio Algom/Inmet raise Antamina resource.

text.p: Rio Algom Ltd and Inmet Mining Corp said on Wednesday that interim drilling results from their Antamina copper and zinc property in Peru showed a resource of at least 400 million tonnes.

The results from 61 drill holes showed ore grading an average of 1.2 percent copper, 1.1 percent zinc and 13 grams of silver per tonne of ore. Of that, measured and indicated resources totaled 200 million tonnes, averaging 1.3 percent copper, 1.1 percent zinc and 15 grams of silver per tonne.

"These results exceed our initial tonnage objective and the deposit has further potential," Gordon Gray and Bill James, chief executives, respectively, of Rio Algom and Inmet said in a joint statement.
"We are proceeding with a full feasibility study," they said.
